dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: I have to sort the previously-recorded data... Oh, it's you. Hello there. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your potions...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: I've recorded the various data gathered from our previous trials. Thanks so much for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: However, I'm still not sure what happened with that last type of potion... Only the Master Potioneer can tell you that, I'm afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Carabosse...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Ah, she does often have impressive, curious ideas. She really does know how to use unexpected things as potions ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Her bold, "well, I'm not the one trying the potions regardless" attitude toward formula design is most enviable.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: There is much I still need to learn from her...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, it's nothing, really.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: W—Well, in that case, thanks so much for helping me test the potions! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need any further help?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: We've completed the trials for three types of potions, so there's not much help needed at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: As for the sorting of notes and data, I believe I can handle that myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've got this!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Yes. I will — I want to help more people, and help the Master Potioneer make more effective potions.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Ah, right. While the Master Potioneer is here, I should ask about the effects of some of these ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Hmm? Would you like my help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your potions...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Yes. Thanks to your help previously, we were able to obtain much data concerning the Truesight Potion...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: With that data, I'm sure the Master Potioneer will be able to improve her potions. This is all thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need any further help?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: We don't have any formulae that need testing at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: We do have some notes and data from the previous tests that need sorting, but there aren't that many of those — I can handle them myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Agh! The potions I just made! They've all spilled out!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: We'll have to start back from square one! ... Come on, what was all that shaking just now about, anyway!?
